This lichen is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in mountains, and is best known in eastern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

Wifurwif lichen is swallowed to aid the repair of nerve injuries. This rare mountain substance does not express its effect as a fixed restoration of concussion hits. Repeated administration carries a risk of habituation that must remain part of its game data.
